scope: A bounded discovery register of Belgian first-party sources relevant to free movement, third-country family members, visa and residence procedures, administrative process and remedies, cross-border civil-status evidence, privacy, and access to administrative records. It is not an exhaustive Belgian source inventory.

bounded_search_gaps: No official German-speaking Community transparency/access-to-records source was verified. German-language search was bounded and inconclusive; this is not a claim that no such rule or service exists.
Municipal and community-level access-to-records coverage and local registration procedures remain incomplete; the 1994 federal law does not cover every regional, community, or municipal authority.
Only UK and UAE mission examples were inspected. The competence matrix is a routing aid, not a review of every applicant-residence country, local checklist, or outsourced provider.
The RvV/CCE direct site and sample PDF returned HTTP 403; the selected monthly publication is not a complete case-law corpus.
The current Annex 19ter index link returned an HTML error response; a current valid form payload and identity must be rediscovered and checked.

The 2018 Belgian personal-data processing law and several national civil-status/adoption records were not directly verified in this pass; the Code of Private International Law is only a bounded lead for foreign civil-status evidence.
No Belgian runtime retrieval, response validator, converter, offline replay, or repeatable change detector exists; no Belgian API or registration route was verified.
